phase_prompt.prompt_block: Medium shot of Sena, young Ethiopian woman, scavenger archetype. Wearing ragged but intricate layered robes and improvised polymer armor plates on knees. She holds a primitive prying tool. Background is a blurred wall of ancient dark basalt circuitry. High contrast lighting, sweat on skin, detailed texture of woven fabric, 8k, cinematic composition.
